  "rationale": "The columns collectively and tightly centre on ONE coherent, data-inferable focus: the specific film aspects reviewers focus on. This is a faceted decomposition, not a grab-bag or a bare-sentiment restatement, so structure_quality is high; the only mild deduction is that production_quality_focus and technical_craft_focus overlap conceptually, slightly blurring facet boundaries.
